governance.rule: D25: a parameter is approved only when this file marks it approved AND names the decision that approves it. Approved values that reuse an existing contract rule are read from that contract (from_contract), never copied here.

modes.approved_only: default and the only publishable mode: a detector runs only when every parameter it needs is approved; otherwise it records its facts under not_evaluated with rule_not_approved
modes.review: explicit opt-in for management review (never publishable): unapproved parameters use proposed_value and every finding carries parameter_status proposed_not_approved

publication.note: When true, a site build also writes intelligence-v2.json (approved_only) as an optional artifact. Turning it off again needs no code change; builds with or without the file both validate and roll back.

deadline.minimum_comparator_projects.meaning: minimum deadline-classifiable projects of the other Editors for a late-rate comparison

deadline.minimum_editor_projects.meaning: minimum deadline-classifiable projects of the Editor for a late-rate comparison

quality.minimum_projects.meaning: minimum eligible completed projects before label rates are discussed

recent_change.minimum_sample.meaning: minimum projects in both the current and the comparison window before a window change is discussed

speed.faster_band_pct.meaning: Editor-vs-comparator median difference below which an exact-Video-Type comparison is Faster

speed.minimum_comparator_editors.meaning: minimum other Editors behind a leave-one-out typical execution time

speed.minimum_comparator_projects.meaning: minimum other-Editor projects behind a leave-one-out typical execution time for one Video Type

speed.minimum_editor_projects.meaning: minimum projects an Editor needs in one exact Video Type before their execution time is compared

speed.slower_band_pct.meaning: Editor-vs-comparator median difference above which an exact-Video-Type comparison is Slower

concentration.minimum_share_difference.basis: and at least 10 percentage points in absolute share, so small groups cannot qualify on ratio alone
concentration.minimum_share_difference.meaning: outcome share - base share at or above which an outcome is concentrated

concentration.minimum_share_ratio.basis: outcome share at least 25% above the group's share of the base population
concentration.minimum_share_ratio.meaning: outcome share / base share at or above which an outcome is concentrated in a group

confidence.minimum_completeness.basis: evidence is complete enough when at least 90% of eligible projects carry every field the finding needs
confidence.minimum_completeness.meaning: share of eligible projects with complete fields needed for strong evidence

confidence.sample_multiple.basis: evidence is stronger when every compared group has at least twice its minimum sample
confidence.sample_multiple.meaning: multiple of the minimum sample that counts as a well-supported group

evidence.breadth_share.basis: D53.4: a pattern is shared when the affected Editors are at least two thirds (exactly 2/3) of the qualifying Editors, and at least evidence.minimum_editors_for_breadth of them
evidence.breadth_share.meaning: share of qualifying Editors that must show a pattern for it to be called shared

evidence.material_duration_pct.basis: mirrors the approved D52 Speed band (25%); the same question as the OPEN Trend materiality (D52)
evidence.material_duration_pct.meaning: percentage difference between two median execution times (two groups, or two periods) at or above which the difference is material

evidence.material_rate_difference.basis: mirrors the approved D52 Deadline band (15 percentage points); the same question as the OPEN Trend materiality (D52), so approve both together
evidence.material_rate_difference.meaning: difference between two rates (two groups, or two periods) at or above which the difference is material

evidence.minimum_editors_for_breadth.basis: a cross-Editor statement needs more than the two comparator Editors of D52
evidence.minimum_editors_for_breadth.meaning: minimum qualifying Editors before a pattern is called shared or confined

evidence.minimum_group_projects.basis: mirrors the D52 Quality and Trend floors (10); used for every compared group (a Video Type, an Editor slice, a workload band)
evidence.minimum_group_projects.meaning: minimum projects in any group whose rate or median is compared

evidence.minimum_outcome_events.basis: a share of fewer than 5 outcomes (late projects, labels) is not interpreted
evidence.minimum_outcome_events.meaning: minimum outcome events (late projects, label occurrences) behind a concentration or pattern

evidence.minimum_projects_per_editor_for.basis: mirrors the D52 Speed subject minimum (5 per Video Type)
evidence.minimum_projects_per_editor_for.meaning: minimum projects an Editor needs in a slice to count towards breadth

patterns.maximum_combinations.basis: caps the controlled search space of repeated-pattern detection; the number of combinations tested is always published
patterns.maximum_combinations.meaning: maximum number of dimension combinations one pattern detector evaluates

prioritization.duplicate_overlap.basis: two findings about the same projects (Jaccard overlap at or above 0.8), the same Video Types and the same direction are one fact
prioritization.duplicate_overlap.meaning: affected-project overlap at or above which findings are clustered as duplicates

prioritization.top_findings.basis: a management brief shows at most five findings; everything else stays in its section
prioritization.top_findings.meaning: maximum findings in Top Findings and the Executive Brief

risk.elapsed_percentile.basis: an active project has been in execution longer than the 75th percentile of historical same-Video-Type execution
risk.elapsed_percentile.meaning: percentile of historical execution time beyond which active work is a risk signal

runway.short_rule.basis: a project's runway (Requested ETA - first In Progress) is short when it is below the leave-one-out median execution time of other Editors in the same exact Video Type (the D36 benchmark and D52 minimums); no new number
runway.short_rule.meaning: definition of a short execution runway

workload.band_rule.basis: a project started at high concurrency when the Editor's other open projects at its start exceed that Editor's own median; no universal overload threshold (brief Task 26, HANDOFF §21)
workload.band_rule.meaning: how a project is placed in the low or high concurrent-workload band

workload.high_percentile.basis: D53.8: a materially high current workload is judged against the same Editor's own historical concurrency distribution, never a universal number
workload.high_percentile.meaning: percentile of the Editor's own historical concurrent workload above which their current open workload is a high-workload risk signal
